business_problem: Hargreaves Lansdown (HL) is one of the UK’s leading financial services companies, managing more than £134 billion (US$165 billion) in assets for 1.8 million clients. For the financial advisors who meet with those clients, delivering exceptional service and building trust is paramount. With the advent of generative AI, HL saw the potential to redefine key business workflows to drive increased productivity with their employees that would result in differentiated experiences for their clients. Case in point, while answering client questions and listening to their concerns in a digital meeting, advisors often found their attention torn between manual notetaking and keeping the conversation moving. After a session, advisors had to manually transfer their notes to a branded template to send to customers. Dispensing personalized advice and professional-looking documentation this way helps HL advisers win the loyalty of clients, but it was a time-consuming process—one that was ripe for optimization.

Within months, the new tools have delivered quantifiable benefits: financial advisors expect to complete client documentation 4 times faster, employees save an estimated 2 to 3 hours per week, and 96 percent find Microsoft 365 Copilot useful in simplifying daily tasks.
